scripts.install: npm i --prefix client-vite && npm i --prefix server
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client-vite
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client-vite
scripts.heroku-postbuild: cd client-vite && npm install && npm run build && cd ../server && npm install && npm run build
